about: A Pokemon transformed into Arceus keeps the form it copied, even holding another plate, from the fifth generation (Pokemon Central, Multitipo; Showdown's Pokemon.transformInto sets it again by the item in gen 4 alone). A level-10 Arceus holding a Flame Plate, its Fire form by Multitype (battler0.form, TYPE_FIRE), is given Splash in the running battle (teach:) against a forced wild Ditto, holding nothing, that knows only Transform: the Ditto becomes an Arceus in the Fire form with Multitype (battler1.species SPECIES_ARCEUS) and stays in it through two turns. Before, Multitype's check asked nothing of a transformed Pokemon and turned the Ditto, with no plate, to the Normal form ("The wild Ditto transformed!") -- a check only reached since Transform copies the ability again. The field's RNG is pinned as in rolls_forced_high.json.

lines: The wild Ditto transformed into Arceus!
